what: Z8 on the real board. The research service (port 3040) was stopped with kill -TERM and its listener was confirmed gone; the deployment image ran with a test enrollment (replay backend, KDF c = 4049). From the PC: 100 research-protocol commands (PUF-COLP v1 frames that read responses, challenges from the Z3 set, none in K), then 10 line-JSON impostors, then one unlock with the right passphrase, one derive and a lock. 'evaluations' in the service log counts reads of K and must rise only for the unlock. The research service was then restarted (same frozen firmware, --no-program).
